reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 2 (p0011) creates an evergreen term running until terminated, with no 'automatically renew' mechanic, no renewal term length, and no non-renewal notice window — so none of the 30/60/90-day thresholds or multi-year-renewal walk-away triggers are engaged.

Commitment arises only on affirmative execution of a new Statement of Work, which is functionally equivalent to the preferred 'renewal only by mutual written agreement', and the § 6(a) 15-day convenience exit (p0032) is more favourable than the preferred 30-day opt-out; flagging this would be over-flagging a clause that benefits us.
Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, as expected.

The rate-change observation under § 3(b) is properly parked as an adjacent note for the pricing rule rather than double-flagged here, consistent with the no-duplicate-term instruction. The deterministic check (value=15) reflects the termination notice rather than a true non-renewal window, but this is harmless and does not undermine the compliant conclusion.
